hypothesis: Mechanism: 18 of 59 W1 edit calls failed ('text not found' 17) and the worker fell back to bash (74 of 712 calls failed). Hash-anchored line edits remove the exact-text requirement. Expect the edit-like error rate to drop from 30% to well below, fewer bash edit workarounds, a higher valid and kind-match rate where the case needed edits; cost: about 1k prompt tokens of tool prompts and 1-3 tokens per line read, so context pressure may rise and the median wall time stay flat.
